baseline_models.focus_anchor: The destroyed earlier qarn is explicitly granted comparative superiority in furnishings and visible appearance.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah concedes the strongest visible status evidence and places annihilation over it; the point is not that the former people lacked splendor, but that splendor had no preserving force.

activation_trace.role: Annihilation supplies the terminal operation that cancels the cohort's apparent advantage.
A people joined in one time supplies the social unit whose status is tested.
Desirable beauty supplies the conceded comparative rather than a sarcastic denial of it.
Abundant household goods supply the material half of the superiority claim.
Visible aspect and appearance supply the inspectable half of the claim.

changed_reading.before: Earlier richer and better-looking peoples were also destroyed.
changed_reading.after: The ayah puts the best available status evidence under cross-examination: it grants material and visual superiority, then demonstrates that the granted advantage cannot preserve its bearers.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Qarn, dense athath, and mutually visible ri'y can be read as one assembled social-material display.
baseline_models.mechanism: Binding, density, and visibility make superiority relational: goods, bodies, and peers must be gathered into an arrangement before they can register as status.

activation_trace.role: Binding one thing to another supplies the cohort as an assembled rather than merely counted unit.
Dense accumulation supplies the packed material texture of the display.
Mutual facing and visibility supply the audience relation through which the arrangement becomes comparative.

changed_reading.before: A generation possessed finer furniture and looked better.
changed_reading.after: Its advantage was a bundled social-material arrangement whose density and mutual visibility made it legible as public rank.

context_deltas.mechanism: The qarn becomes one occupancy in a replacement chain: a successor takes a predecessor's place, while inheritance language relocates durable acquisition away from a cohort's self-secured splendor.

activation_trace.role: Temporal precedence locates the splendid cohort as an earlier station in a sequence.
The time-joined people supply one replaceable cohort in that sequence.
A thing coming after and standing in another's place supplies explicit successor substitution.
After opposed to before supplies the directional link between predecessor and successor.
Transfer from predecessor to inheritor supplies an alternative account of what can pass beyond one cohort.

structural_cues: 19:59 places a successor after predecessors, while 19:74 looks before the present audience to an earlier qarn.
19:63 introduces inheritance before 19:74 displays possessions that failed to preserve their holders.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies succession, before/after, inheritance, and a destroyed cohort; I infer that worldly superiority is temporary occupancy rather than secured ownership. A live alternative is that the inheritance language concerns a separate promised domain and only loosely reframes the historical comparison.

changed_reading.before: The verse gives a static example of a former generation's fall.
changed_reading.after: The former generation occupies a transferable historical slot: successors may inherit position and display, but no cohort can convert that temporary occupancy into permanence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible prestige is only the first sight in a delayed epistemic sequence: a promise hidden from present eyes comes, is eventually seen, and overturns the verdict drawn from present appearance.

activation_trace.role: Present visible appearance supplies the initial basis of comparison.
Concealment from eyes supplies the presently unavailable side of the evaluation.
Coming and arrival give the hidden promise temporal movement toward disclosure.
Actual seeing supplies the later observation that replaces the status-bearing first view.
A promise bounded by an appointed time or place connects deferred disclosure to what had been unseen.

structural_cues: 19:61 joins the unseen to a promise characterized as coming.
19:74 names superior visible appearance; 19:75 then uses seeing after an extension marked by 'until when'.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden promise, arrival, present appearance, and later seeing; I infer a two-sight reversal in which the later view judges the earlier one. The alternative is a simpler warning in which the repeated seeing vocabulary is not a designed epistemic sequence.

changed_reading.before: Historical destruction proves that attractive appearance is unreliable.
changed_reading.after: The ayah marks present appearance as a provisional first frame: the hidden outcome advances toward a second seeing that will reverse the comparison.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding boast stages rank through a better station and finer council; the focus ayah mirrors its comparative and answers with earlier communities whose even stronger material-visual staging still ended.

activation_trace.role: Many goods supply the material apparatus that answers the prior claim of superior station.
Performance for human observers supplies the socially displayed edge of the focus comparison.
Station and residence supply the setting in which rank is claimed.
The repeated desirable comparative directly links the boast to the counterexample.
The assembled council supplies the peer audience that makes status publicly legible.

structural_cues: 19:73 asks which of two parties is better in station and finer in council.
19:74 is adjacent, retains the comparative 'better,' and escalates from the present parties to many destroyed cohorts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, repeated comparative language, station, council, furnishings, and appearance; I infer that 19:74 is a mirrored rebuttal using the boasters' own metric. The alternative is a general historical warning with no special claim about status performance.

changed_reading.before: The verse generally warns rich people by recalling richer predecessors.
changed_reading.after: It is a targeted reply to a public prestige argument: the council's visible ranking apparatus is granted, scaled up historically, and shown unable to certify the winning party.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah replaces accumulated appearance with persistence and return: what survives and what comes back to its doer become the counter-metric to goods whose owners undergo annihilation.

activation_trace.role: Annihilation supplies the failure condition against which durability is measured.
Abundant possessions supply the impressive but non-preserving asset class.
Continuance and remaining supply the explicit durability criterion.
A deed's recompense returning to its doer supplies value measured by consequential return.
Return to a place or state supplies the terminal horizon against which present display is valued.

structural_cues: 19:76 twice uses a better-than comparison after 19:74's 'better' furnishings and appearance.
The later comparison explicitly joins remaining deeds to reward and return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies annihilation, abundant goods, remaining deeds, recompense, and return; I infer that 19:76 supplies the durability test implicit in 19:74. The alternative is that the two comparisons are parallel exhortations without a shared metric.

changed_reading.before: The verse says worldly splendor eventually disappears.
changed_reading.after: The verse participates in a value audit: superiority is not what accumulates or photographs well, but what remains through annihilation and returns as consequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines a secondary supplied mapping for ri'y with branch-distant ecological images of halaka and athath. It remains anchored at focus words 2, 8, and 9 and the packet explicitly supplies thirst/saturation, dense growth, and rainless barrenness; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy, not as the lexical sense of the clause.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Athath can image dense growth, the secondary r-w-y mapping can image saturation, and halaka can image rainless barrenness.

activation_trace.role: Rainless barren land supplies desiccation as an exploratory material image of destruction.
Thick, tangled growth supplies lush density beneath the furnishing term.
Satiation opposed to thirst supplies fullness beneath the packet's secondary root mapping.

changed_reading.before: The predecessors had more possessions and a finer outward look.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their superiority forms a lush, saturated surface whose destruction can be felt as desiccation: visible fullness is a condition, not a guarantee.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates qarn's binding image rather than taking only its ordinary cohort sense. It remains valid as a cross-domain model because the focus binds qarn to dense display and the nearby packet supplies compelled gathering followed by extraction from each faction; downstream prose should say 'as if assembled and unbound,' not redefine qarn literally.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The qarn's supplied binding branch and athath's density allow the prestigious cohort to register as a packed formation.

activation_trace.role: Binding one thing to another supplies the cohort's exploratory assembled texture.
Dense accumulation supplies the packed surface of that formation.
Driving and gathering a group to one destination supplies compelled reassembly.
Pulling a thing from its settled place supplies disassembly by extraction.
A mutually supporting faction supplies the collective from which an element is pulled.

changed_reading.before: A historically earlier generation with dense wealth was destroyed.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, prestige is a packed cohort-display that can be gathered, opened, and plucked apart; its impressive cohesion is itself temporary.

strongest_changes: The focus comparison becomes a mirrored rebuttal to 19:73's public claim of better station and council.
Present ri'y becomes the first frame of a hidden-to-arriving-to-seen sequence whose later sight reverses the verdict.
19:76 supplies persistence and consequential return as the counter-metric to abundant but non-preserving display.
summary.what_was_special: The trace links social staging, temporal disclosure, and durability without denying the predecessors' actual splendor; the packet's split mapping for ri'y also preserves a contained saturation/desiccation outlier.
remaining_uncertainties: The r-w-y saturation reading is explicitly exploratory and should not displace the dominant r-hamza-y appearance reading.
The succession/inheritance model depends on treating nearby transfer language as a reframing of cohort possession rather than a separate promised domain.
The binding/plucking model is mechanism-level imagery, not a claim that qarn literally means an assembled object here.
